contexts.text: (Hebron) given to Caleb as to field and villages () = again a new Church.
In their villages () = the external things of the Church... These were represented by villages, because they were outside the cities.
When man passes from the natural world into the Spiritual World, it is like passing from a village into a great city.
Matrimony is contracted within the region, city, or village...
We saw... villages and villages, with gardens, groves, and fields between them.
A cloud... which hides fields, villages, and cities.
(At the Last Judgment, the Lord) deluged their cities, villages, and fields. SE 5094. SE 5283. SE 5359. SE 5366.
Villages () = natural Knowledges and scientifics. AE 730:29.
